Animate grandma

“animate this photo of my grandma so she smiles and waves, like 5 seconds”

1 tool calls · 1 execution levels · 0 unsolved

Step 1 · Creative director: story

Input

“animate this photo of my grandma so she smiles and waves, like 5 seconds”

Uploads: One photo: an elderly woman with short white hair, round glasses and a green cardigan, sitting in an armchair in a sunlit living room, looking at the camera with a neutral expression.

Output

Creative director, GPT-6.1 Sol (story prompt, v3a)

In a sunlit living room, your grandma sits comfortably in her armchair, wearing a green cardigan and round glasses, her short white hair softly lit by the daylight. She begins with the same neutral expression as in the photo, looking toward you. Over about five seconds, her face brightens into a gentle smile. She lifts one hand and gives a small, friendly wave, then settles back, still smiling. The moment feels warm and familiar, like a quiet hello.

Step 2 · Creative director: change-based operational chunks

Input

The story from step 1.

Output

Change-based operational chunks, GPT-6.1 Sol (v5b)

Show chunks
Baseline — first frame
  • Source and character: Use the uploaded photo. Preserve Grandma’s identity, age, facial features, skin texture, short white hair, round glasses, green cardigan, and any other visible clothing or accessories.
  • Starting pose: Seated comfortably in her armchair, with the same neutral expression, camera-facing gaze, posture, and hand positions as in the photo.
  • Objects and products: Preserve the armchair and all visible furnishings and objects exactly as photographed. Add no products or props.
  • Environment: The same sunlit living room; retain its layout and background.
  • Time of day and lighting: Daytime, with the source photo’s soft daylight, shadows, and highlights.
  • Palette: Preserve the photograph’s colors, including the green cardigan and warm daylight.
  • Style: Subtle, photorealistic photo animation. Natural facial and hand movement; no redesign or stylization.
  • Camera and framing: Locked camera; preserve the original composition. No zoom, pan, or crop.
  • Aspect ratio: Match the uploaded photo’s native aspect ratio.
  • On-screen text: None.
  • Audio: Silent; no speech, music, or sound effects.
  • Total duration: Approximately 5 seconds.
  • Overall feeling: Warm and familiar, like a quiet hello.
Chunk 1 — Gentle smile

Quote: “In a sunlit living room, your grandma sits comfortably in her armchair, wearing a green cardigan and round glasses, her short white hair softly lit by the daylight. She begins with the same neutral expression as in the photo, looking toward you. Over about five seconds, her face brightens into a gentle smile.”

Signpost: “Over about five seconds”

Changes:

  • Facial expression: neutral → gentle smile, developing gradually.

Type: continuous Duration: 2 seconds Depends on: none — starts from the baseline

Chunk 2 — Lift and wave

Quote: “She lifts one hand and gives a small, friendly wave, then settles back, still smiling.”

Signpost: implicit

Changes:

  • One hand and its arm position: original resting position → comfortably raised for a greeting.
  • Raised hand motion: still → small, friendly waving motion.

Type: continuous Duration: 2 seconds Depends on: Chunk 1

Chunk 3 — Settle back

Quote: “She lifts one hand and gives a small, friendly wave, then settles back, still smiling. The moment feels warm and familiar, like a quiet hello.”

Signpost: “then”

Changes:

  • Raised hand motion: small, friendly wave → wave ends.
  • Waving hand and arm position: raised → original relaxed resting position.

Type: continuous Duration: 1 second Depends on: Chunk 2

Bakery ad

“ad for my bakery, 20 sec, the end card must say exactly 'Sweet Crumbs — Open 7am–3pm, 12 Elm St' dont spell anything wrong”

21 tool calls · 13 execution levels · 0 unsolved

Step 1 · Creative director: story

Input

“ad for my bakery, 20 sec, the end card must say exactly 'Sweet Crumbs — Open 7am–3pm, 12 Elm St' dont spell anything wrong”

Uploads: None.

Output

Creative director, GPT-6.1 Sol (story prompt, v3a)

In this twenty-second ad, morning sunlight warms Sweet Crumbs, a cozy bakery with wooden shelves and a glass counter full of golden pastries. A baker in a flour-dusted apron lifts a tray of croissants from the oven. Their crisp, buttery layers glisten beside soft cinnamon rolls and thick chocolate-chip cookies.

A customer steps inside as the doorbell gently chimes. The baker smiles and hands over a small pastry box. The customer breaks open a warm croissant, revealing its tender center, and takes a delighted bite. The mood is comforting, cheerful, and inviting—a little sweetness to start the day.

The ad ends with an end card displaying exactly:

Sweet Crumbs — Open 7am–3pm, 12 Elm St

Step 2 · Creative director: change-based operational chunks

Input

The story from step 1.

Output

Change-based operational chunks, GPT-6.1 Sol (v5b)

Show chunks
Baseline — first-frame state

Total duration: exactly 20 seconds. Aspect ratio: 16:9. Style: polished, photorealistic live-action bakery ad; gentle camera movement and natural performances. No uploaded reference assets.

Characters and consistent traits
  • Baker: adult with short dark hair, wearing a navy shirt and a cream, flour-dusted apron. Wearing oven mitts, standing at the open oven with hands gripping a tray that is still inside. Expression is relaxed and neutral.
  • Customer: adult with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a mustard jacket over a teal shirt. Just outside the closed entrance door, visible through its glass.
Products and objects
  • Croissants: golden, glossy, visibly laminated, with crisp buttery layers and tender interiors.
  • Cinnamon rolls: soft, golden rolls arranged on the display counter.
  • Chocolate-chip cookies: thick cookies with visible chocolate chips, arranged beside the cinnamon rolls.
  • Oven and tray: open oven behind the counter; metal tray holding croissants remains inside it.
  • Pastry box: small kraft-paper box on the service counter, lid closed, containing one warm croissant.
  • Other fixtures: wooden shelves, a glass counter full of golden pastries, and a glass entrance door with a doorbell.
Environment and presentation
  • Location: Sweet Crumbs, a cozy bakery.
  • Time: morning throughout the live-action footage.
  • Lighting: warm sunlight through the front windows, with soft interior fill.
  • Palette: golden pastry tones, warm cream, natural wood brown, and restrained clothing accents.
  • Opening framing: wide interior view encompassing the shelves, display counter, entrance, and baker at the oven.
  • Mood: comforting, cheerful, and inviting.
  • On-screen text: none.
  • Audio: soft, cheerful acoustic instrumental music and quiet bakery room tone. No dialogue or voice-over; doorbell initially silent.
Chunk 1 — Morning welcome

Quote: > In this twenty-second ad, morning sunlight warms Sweet Crumbs, a cozy bakery with wooden shelves and a glass counter full of golden pastries.

Signpost: “In this twenty-second ad”

Changes:

  • Camera framing: wide bakery interior → slightly tighter view emphasizing the baker, oven, and pastry counter.
  • Camera movement: stationary → gentle forward push → settled.

Type: continuous Duration: 2 seconds, 0:00–0:02 Depends on: none

Chunk 2 — Fresh from the oven

Quote: > A baker in a flour-dusted apron lifts a tray of croissants from the oven.

Signpost: implicit

Changes:

  • Tray location: inside the open oven → outside the oven, supported in the baker’s hands.
  • Baker’s arm position: reaching into the oven → holding the tray at waist height.

Type: continuous Duration: 3 seconds, 0:02–0:05 Depends on: Chunk 1

Chunk 3 — Pastry detail

Quote: > Their crisp, buttery layers glisten beside soft cinnamon rolls and thick chocolate-chip cookies.

Signpost: implicit

Changes:

  • Camera framing: baker and oven view → close-up of croissants beside the cinnamon rolls and cookies.
  • Tray location: in the baker’s hands → resting on the counter beside the other pastries.
  • Baker’s hands: supporting the tray → free.
  • Oven mitts: worn on the baker’s hands → resting beside the tray.

Type: cut Duration: 2 seconds, 0:05–0:07 Depends on: Chunk 2

Chunk 4 — Customer arrival

Quote: > A customer steps inside as the doorbell gently chimes.

Signpost: “as”

Changes:

  • Camera framing: pastry close-up → medium-wide view of the entrance and service counter.
  • Customer location: outside the bakery → inside, approaching the service counter.
  • Entrance door: closed → opens for the customer → closes.

Type: cut Duration: 2 seconds, 0:07–0:09

On-screen text and audio:

  • Audio: gentle doorbell chime starts as the door opens, then fades out before the chunk ends.

Depends on: Chunk 3

Chunk 5 — Friendly handoff

Quote: > The baker smiles and hands over a small pastry box.

Signpost: implicit

Changes:

  • Baker’s expression: relaxed and neutral → welcoming smile.
  • Customer location: approaching the service counter → standing at the counter.
  • Pastry box location: resting on the service counter → lifted by the baker → held by the customer.
  • Baker’s hand position: free → presenting the box → released after handoff.
  • Customer’s hand position: at their sides → receiving and holding the box.

Type: continuous Duration: 3 seconds, 0:09–0:12 Depends on: Chunk 4

Chunk 6 — The delighted bite

Quote: > The customer breaks open a warm croissant, revealing its tender center, and takes a delighted bite. The mood is comforting, cheerful, and inviting—a little sweetness to start the day.

Signpost: implicit

Changes:

  • Camera framing: medium-wide counter view → medium close-up encompassing the customer’s face and hands.
  • Pastry box location: held by the customer → resting on the counter.
  • Pastry box lid: closed → open.
  • Box contents: one warm croissant → empty.
  • Croissant location: inside the box → held in the customer’s hands.
  • Croissant condition: whole → broken open with tender center exposed → one piece bitten.
  • Customer’s expression: pleasant anticipation → visible delight.
  • Customer’s hand position: holding the box → breaking the croissant → raising one piece to their mouth.

Type: cut Duration: 4 seconds, 0:12–0:16 Depends on: Chunk 5

Chunk 7 — Exact end card

Quote: > The ad ends with an end card displaying exactly: > > Sweet Crumbs — Open 7am–3pm, 12 Elm St

Signpost: “The ad ends”

Changes:

  • Frame content: live-action customer close-up → full-screen end card.
  • Background: bakery footage → solid warm-cream field.
  • Visible characters and objects: customer, pastry, box, and bakery → hidden by the end card.

Type: cut Duration: 4 seconds, 0:16–0:20

On-screen text and audio:

Sweet Crumbs — Open 7am–3pm, 12 Elm St

Energy drink, 6 shots

“product ad for my energy drink, 6 shots, the can has to look exactly like my photo with the logo in every single shot”

16 tool calls · 10 execution levels · 0 unsolved

Step 1 · Creative director: story

Input

“product ad for my energy drink, 6 shots, the can has to look exactly like my photo with the logo in every single shot”

Uploads: One product photo: a matte black 355 ml can with a neon green lightning-bolt logo and the word VOLT in white capital letters, on a plain white background.

Output

Creative director, GPT-6.1 Sol (story prompt, v3a)

A matte black 355 ml can stands alone on a plain white surface against a plain white background. It looks exactly like the supplied product photo: the neon green lightning-bolt logo and the word VOLT in white capital letters are fully visible. The space is immaculate and silent, with the can’s dark finish giving it a bold, unmistakable presence.

A thin line of green light appears on the surface beside the can. It advances like a spark finding its path, tracing an angular route around the base. The can remains unchanged, its neon green lightning-bolt logo and white VOLT lettering clearly visible. The stillness begins to feel charged.

The white surroundings darken to charcoal, revealing the surface as a smooth platform in a vast, empty room. Green light spreads outward through narrow grooves in the floor. At the center stands the same matte black 355 ml can, exactly matching the reference, with its lightning-bolt logo and VOLT lettering unobstructed. A low vibration builds through the room.

The illuminated grooves flare into branching patterns, racing toward the walls. Brief green sparks leap between distant metal structures, filling the space with restless movement. The can remains steady amid the activity, its original matte black finish, neon green lightning-bolt logo, and white VOLT lettering intact and fully visible.

A bright green pulse sweeps through the room. The floor’s scattered lines light up together, forming one enormous lightning-bolt pattern beneath the platform. Everything that was dormant now feels alive. The unchanged can stands at the heart of it, its own neon green lightning-bolt logo and white VOLT lettering plainly visible.

The pulse fades, and the room returns to pure white. The same matte black 355 ml can remains alone on the plain white surface, looking exactly like the supplied photo, with the neon green lightning-bolt logo and white VOLT lettering fully visible. The last green glimmer disappears beside its base, leaving a clean, confident stillness.

Step 2 · Creative director: change-based operational chunks

Input

The story from step 1.

Output

Change-based operational chunks, GPT-6.1 Sol (v5b)

Show chunks
Baseline — first frame

Structure: Exactly 6 shots, one per chunk. Chunk 1 starts at the baseline; chunks 2–6 begin with cuts. Their listed actions unfold within the new shot.

Production defaults: 16:9 aspect ratio; estimated total duration 24 seconds.

  • Product: One matte black 355 ml VOLT can, matching the supplied photo exactly in shape, proportions, finish, colors, and label placement. Its neon green lightning-bolt logo and white capital-letter VOLT wordmark must remain fully visible and readable in every shot. No redesign, added graphics, deformation, or rotation away from the camera.
  • Characters: None.
  • Objects: The can stands upright, alone, on a plain white surface. No other objects or effects are visible.
  • Environment: Immaculate plain white surface against a seamless plain white background.
  • Time of day: Unspecified; controlled interior with no daylight cues.
  • Lighting: Soft, even, neutral studio lighting. The can retains its matte black finish.
  • Palette: Pure white, matte black, neon green.
  • Style: Photorealistic, clean, premium energy-drink product advertisement.
  • Camera/composition: Centered frontal product view, entire can visible, label facing the camera. All subsequent framing must preserve unobstructed logo and wordmark visibility.
  • On-screen text: Only the existing VOLT lettering on the can; no overlays.
  • Audio: Silence; no music or voice-over.
Chunk 1 — Clean Product Hero

Quote: > A matte black 355 ml can stands alone on a plain white surface against a plain white background. It looks exactly like the supplied product photo: the neon green lightning-bolt logo and the word VOLT in white capital letters are fully visible. The space is immaculate and silent, with the can’s dark finish giving it a bold, unmistakable presence.

Chunk 2 — Spark Around the Base

The can remains unchanged, its neon green lightning-bolt logo and white VOLT lettering clearly visible. The stillness begins to feel charged.

  • Surface light effect: absent → a thin green line appears beside the can and advances along an angular route around its base.
  • Local surface illumination: uniformly neutral white → a narrow green glow follows the advancing line.

Type: cut Duration: 4 seconds Depends on: Chunk 1

Chunk 3 — Charcoal Room Reveal

Quote: > The white surroundings darken to charcoal, revealing the surface as a smooth platform in a vast, empty room. Green light spreads outward through narrow grooves in the floor. At the center stands the same matte black 355 ml can, exactly matching the reference, with its lightning-bolt logo and VOLT lettering unobstructed. A low vibration builds through the room.

Signpost: implicit

Changes:

  • Environment appearance: seamless white surroundings → a vast, empty charcoal room.
  • Supporting surface appearance: plain white surface → a smooth platform at the room’s center.
  • Floor detail visibility: no visible grooves → narrow floor grooves become visible.
  • Green light extent: angular line around the base → illumination spreads outward through the floor grooves.
  • Lighting: bright, neutral studio illumination → subdued charcoal-room illumination with green floor glow; the label remains clearly readable.
  • Framing: centered product view → wider frontal room view showing the platform and spreading floor illumination.
  • Audio state: silence → a low vibration gradually builds.

Type: cut Duration: 4 seconds On-screen text and audio: Start a low, building vibration; no music or voice-over. Depends on: Chunk 2

Chunk 4 — Branching Energy

Quote: > The illuminated grooves flare into branching patterns, racing toward the walls. Brief green sparks leap between distant metal structures, filling the space with restless movement. The can remains steady amid the activity, its original matte black finish, neon green lightning-bolt logo, and white VOLT lettering intact and fully visible.

Signpost: implicit

Changes:

  • Floor illumination pattern: outward-spreading narrow illuminated grooves → brighter branching patterns racing toward the walls.
  • Distant structure visibility: no metal structures visible → distant metal structures become visible at the room’s periphery.
  • Airborne light effects: absent → brief green sparks leap between the distant metal structures.
  • Environmental light activity: spreading floor glow → restless branching flares and intermittent spark flashes.

Type: cut Duration: 4 seconds Depends on: Chunk 3

Chunk 5 — Giant Lightning-Bolt Pulse

Quote: > A bright green pulse sweeps through the room. The floor’s scattered lines light up together, forming one enormous lightning-bolt pattern beneath the platform. Everything that was dormant now feels alive. The unchanged can stands at the heart of it, its own neon green lightning-bolt logo and white VOLT lettering plainly visible.

Signpost: implicit

Changes:

  • Room-wide pulse: absent → a bright green pulse sweeps through the room.
  • Floor illumination pattern: scattered branching lines → the lines illuminate together as one enormous lightning-bolt pattern beneath the platform.
  • Environmental illumination: intermittent branching flares → a synchronized, room-wide green surge.
  • Framing: wider frontal room view → a wider, slightly elevated frontal view revealing the enormous floor pattern while keeping the can’s logo and VOLT lettering readable.

Type: cut Duration: 5 seconds Depends on: Chunk 4

Chunk 6 — Return to White

Quote: > The pulse fades, and the room returns to pure white. The same matte black 355 ml can remains alone on the plain white surface, looking exactly like the supplied photo, with the neon green lightning-bolt logo and white VOLT lettering fully visible. The last green glimmer disappears beside its base, leaving a clean, confident stillness.

Signpost: “The pulse fades”

Changes:

  • Room-wide pulse: bright green pulse → fades completely.
  • Environment appearance: charcoal room → seamless pure white background.
  • Supporting surface appearance: smooth platform within the room → plain white surface.
  • Floor detail visibility: illuminated grooves and enormous lightning-bolt pattern → no visible grooves or floor pattern.
  • Distant structure visibility: visible peripheral metal structures → no other objects visible.
  • Airborne light effects: intermittent green sparks → absent.
  • Residual surface light: active green floor illumination → one last glimmer beside the base, which disappears completely.
  • Lighting: energized green room illumination → soft, even, neutral studio lighting.
  • Framing: wider, slightly elevated room view → the opening centered frontal product view.
  • Audio state: low vibration → fades to silence.

Lighthouse short film

“A short film, 2 minutes. A lighthouse keeper finds a glowing shell on the beach at dawn. She brings it home. At night it hums and the lamp goes out. She climbs the tower in a storm and uses the shell to relight it. Ships are saved. Morning again, she puts the shell back on the beach. Melancholy, painterly, no dialogue, just score.”

67 tool calls · 39 execution levels · 0 unsolved

Step 1 · Creative director: story

Input

“A short film, 2 minutes. A lighthouse keeper finds a glowing shell on the beach at dawn. She brings it home. At night it hums and the lamp goes out. She climbs the tower in a storm and uses the shell to relight it. Ships are saved. Morning again, she puts the shell back on the beach. Melancholy, painterly, no dialogue, just score.”

Uploads: None.

Output

Creative director, GPT-6.1 Sol (story prompt, v3a)

At dawn, the beach lies beneath a wash of pearl-grey light. Pools between the rocks hold the pale sky; ribbons of kelp mark the retreating tide. Above the shore stands a weathered lighthouse, its white walls stained by salt.

The keeper walks alone along the waterline, her coat hanging heavily from narrow shoulders. Among the broken shells, something glows.

She kneels. A small spiral shell rests in the sand, lit from within by a soft amber radiance. She turns it in her palm, and its light warms her weathered fingers. For a moment she remains there, reluctant to disturb it. Then she carries it home.

In the cottage beneath the tower, she places the shell beside a chipped cup on the kitchen table. Its glow persists through the fading day, a small warmth among worn wood, faded blue walls and neatly mended clothes. She eats alone, occasionally looking toward it.

At night, the shell begins to hum—a low, trembling thread within the musical score. Beyond the window, a storm gathers. Rain obscures the sea, and the lighthouse lamp goes out.

Far offshore, several ships drift toward the dark reef.

The keeper takes the shell and climbs the tower. Wind presses rain through the narrow windows. She grips the iron railing, ascending the worn steps with the shell held against her chest. Its light spills between her fingers.

At the top, she stands beside the extinguished lamp. She opens its glass housing and brings the shell close to the dark burner. Amber light gathers there, faint at first, then bright enough to illuminate her face. The lamp catches.

Its beam returns across the storm-dark water. The keeper watches it pass over the ships. One changes course, then another; their lights move steadily away from the reef toward open sea. She stays beside the lamp until they are safe.

Morning comes softly. The storm has left scattered weed and driftwood along the beach.

The keeper returns to the place where she found the shell. She kneels and settles it into the wet sand. Its glow is faint now, almost lost in the dawn.

Her hand lingers beside it before she stands. She walks back toward the lighthouse as a thin sheet of water reaches the shell. The score fades, and the returning tide leaves its spiral resting in the pale morning light.

Step 2 · Creative director: change-based operational chunks

Input

The story from step 1.

Output

Change-based operational chunks, GPT-6.1 Sol (v5b)

Show chunks
Baseline — full state at the first frame

Runtime: 120 seconds, exactly 2 minutes. Aspect ratio: 16:9. Style: Melancholy, painterly short film; textured surfaces, softly blended light, restrained movement and naturalistic proportions. No dialogue, captions, titles or logos. Palette: Pearl grey, slate blue, faded blue, weathered white and muted brown, with the shell’s amber glow as the principal warm accent. Audio: A restrained, melancholy instrumental score is already playing. No dialogue or separate environmental sound effects. The shell’s later hum will be represented within the score.

Characters and persistent objects
  • Keeper: One woman, alone; narrow shoulders, weathered hands, subdued expression. For visual continuity: greying hair tied back, a heavy charcoal coat, muted practical clothing with neat repairs, and dark boots. She starts standing just outside the opening composition, beside the waterline. Her hands are empty.
  • Shell: A small spiral shell resting among broken shells in beach sand. It already emits a soft internal amber glow, but is not distinguishable in the opening wide shot.
  • Lighthouse: Above the shore; weathered white walls stained by salt. Its tower contains worn stairs, an iron railing, narrow windows and a lamp with a glass housing and burner. The lamp is operating; its housing is closed.
  • Cottage: Beneath the tower. Worn wooden kitchen table, faded blue walls, neatly mended clothes, a chipped cup, and a simple meal with an eating utensil. These are initially off-screen.
  • Ships: Several vessels far offshore, initially travelling steadily in open water. Their navigation lights are on.
  • Reef: A fixed dark reef offshore.
  • Products: None.
Environment, time and lighting
  • Dawn on a rocky beach during a retreating tide.
  • Pools between the rocks reflect the pale sky; ribbons of kelp and broken shells lie along the shore.
  • No storm or rain yet. The sea is relatively calm.
  • Diffuse pearl-grey daylight illuminates the beach. Cottage interiors receive subdued window light; the operating lighthouse lamp supplies its own light.
  • No fresh storm-cast driftwood is present yet.

Opening composition: A wide view of beach, reflective rock pools and kelp, with the lighthouse above the shore. The keeper, cottage interior, individual shell and ships are not yet distinguishable.

Inheritance rule: Each chunk starts from the end state of its dependency. A cut changes the view, not the existence or condition of objects left off-screen. Everything not listed under Changes remains unchanged.

Quote: “At dawn, the beach lies beneath a wash of pearl-grey light. Pools between the rocks hold the pale sky; ribbons of kelp mark the retreating tide. Above the shore stands a weathered lighthouse, its white walls stained by salt.”

  • Keeper activity: finished placing the shell → eating, with occasional glances toward it.
  • Meal: untouched → partly eaten.
  • Eating utensil: resting on the table → in use.

Type: cut Duration: 5 seconds Depends on: 7

Chunk 9 — The night hum

Quote: “At night, the shell begins to hum—a low, trembling thread within the musical score.”

Signpost: “At night”

Changes:

  • Framing: keeper eating → close view of the shell on the table.
  • Time: dusk → night.
  • Kitchen ambient light: fading daylight → darkness, with the shell providing the visible warm light.
  • Score texture: instrumental score without the shell motif → score containing a low, trembling humming thread.

Type: cut Duration: 6 seconds On-screen text and audio: The shell’s hum begins as an instrumental layer within the score; no separate sound effect or voice. Depends on: 8

Chunk 10 — Storm and blackout

Quote: “Beyond the window, a storm gathers. Rain obscures the sea, and the lighthouse lamp goes out.”

Signpost: implicit

Changes:

  • Framing: shell close-up → view through the cottage window toward the sea and lighthouse.
  • Weather: calm, rain-free night → gathering storm with wind and heavy rain.
  • Sea surface: relatively calm → storm-roughened.
  • Sea visibility: unobscured → veiled by rain.
  • Lighthouse lamp: operating → extinguished.
  • Lighthouse beam: present → absent.

Type: cut Duration: 6 seconds Depends on: 9

Chunk 11 — Ships approaching danger

Quote: “Far offshore, several ships drift toward the dark reef.”

Signpost: “Far offshore”

Changes:

  • Shot location: cottage window view → offshore view of ships and reef.
  • Ships’ movement: steady travel in open water → drifting toward the reef.
  • Ships’ distance from reef: safely offshore → closing toward danger.

Type: cut Duration: 4 seconds Depends on: 10

Chunk 12 — Taking the shell into the tower

Quote: “The keeper takes the shell and climbs the tower.”

Signpost: implicit

Changes:

  • Shot location: offshore → lower tower stairs.
  • Keeper position: seated at the kitchen table → ascending the tower’s lower stairs.
  • Keeper activity: eating → carrying the shell and climbing.
  • Eating utensil: in use → left with the meal.
  • Shell position: kitchen tabletop → keeper’s hand, held against her chest.

Type: cut Duration: 5 seconds Depends on: 11

Chunk 13 — The storm ascent

Quote: “Wind presses rain through the narrow windows. She grips the iron railing, ascending the worn steps with the shell held against her chest. Its light spills between her fingers.”

Signpost: implicit

Changes:

  • Framing: lower stair view → close tracking view along the ascent.
  • Tower interior exposure: dry interior → wind-driven rain entering through the narrow windows.
  • Keeper position: lower stairs → upper stairs.
  • Keeper’s free hand: unbraced → gripping the iron railing.
  • Shell-light visibility: mostly enclosed against her chest → visible through gaps between her fingers.

Type: continuous Duration: 8 seconds Depends on: 12

Chunk 14 — Opening the lamp

Quote: “At the top, she stands beside the extinguished lamp. She opens its glass housing and brings the shell close to the dark burner.”

Signpost: “At the top”

Changes:

  • Shot location: upper stairs → lantern room.
  • Keeper position: ascending stairs → beside the extinguished lamp.
  • Keeper activity: climbing → opening the housing and presenting the shell.
  • Keeper’s railing hand: gripping railing → released and manipulating the housing.
  • Lamp housing: closed → open.
  • Shell position: against keeper’s chest → close to the dark burner.

Type: cut Duration: 6 seconds Depends on: 13

Chunk 15 — The lamp catches

Quote: “Amber light gathers there, faint at first, then bright enough to illuminate her face. The lamp catches.”

Signpost: “faint at first, then”

Changes:

  • Framing: keeper beside the lamp → close view of burner, shell and keeper’s face.
  • Burner illumination: dark → faint amber accumulation → bright amber light.
  • Keeper’s face illumination: dim shell spill → strong warm illumination.
  • Lighthouse lamp: extinguished → burning.

Type: cut Duration: 7 seconds Depends on: 14

Chunk 16 — The beam returns

Quote: “Its beam returns across the storm-dark water. The keeper watches it pass over the ships.”

Signpost: implicit

Changes:

  • Framing: close view of ignition → view past the keeper toward the sea.
  • Lighthouse beam: absent over the sea → sweeping across storm-dark water and ships.
  • Keeper attention: burner → ships illuminated by the returning beam.

Type: cut Duration: 6 seconds Depends on: 15

Chunk 17 — Clearing the reef

Quote: “One changes course, then another; their lights move steadily away from the reef toward open sea. She stays beside the lamp until they are safe.”

Signpost: “then another”; “until they are safe”

Changes:

  • Framing: view past keeper → closer offshore view of ships and reef.
  • Ships’ course: drifting toward reef → turning away sequentially toward open sea.
  • Ships’ distance from reef: closing → steadily increasing.
  • Ships’ safety: threatened by reef → clear of danger.
  • Time: immediately after relighting → later that night, with the rescue interval compressed.

Type: cut Duration: 8 seconds Depends on: 16

Chunk 18 — Morning after the storm

Quote: “Morning comes softly. The storm has left scattered weed and driftwood along the beach.”

Signpost: “Morning comes softly”

Changes:

  • Shot location: offshore ships → beach.
  • Time: night → following dawn.
  • Weather: active storm → storm passed, no falling rain.
  • Wind-driven rain entering tower: active → stopped.
  • Sea surface: storm-roughened → settling.
  • Ambient light: storm-dark night → soft pearl-grey morning.
  • Beach debris: existing kelp and broken shells → additional scattered storm-cast weed and driftwood.

Type: cut Duration: 3 seconds Depends on: 17

Chunk 19 — Returning the shell

Quote: “The keeper returns to the place where she found the shell. She kneels and settles it into the wet sand.”

Signpost: implicit

Changes:

  • Framing: beach establishing view → keeper at the original shell-finding spot.
  • Keeper position: beside the tower lamp → original beach location.
  • Keeper posture: standing → kneeling.
  • Keeper activity: watching from the lantern room → settling the shell into sand.
  • Shell position: held near the burner → wet sand at its original location.
  • Keeper’s shell-holding hand: carrying shell → released beside it.

Type: cut Duration: 6 seconds Depends on: 18

Chunk 20 — A diminished glow

Quote: “Its glow is faint now, almost lost in the dawn.”

Signpost: “now”

Changes:

  • Framing: keeper returning shell → close view of the shell in wet sand.
  • Shell radiance: soft, clearly visible amber → faint amber, nearly overwhelmed by dawn light.

Type: cut Duration: 3 seconds Depends on: 19

Chunk 21 — The lingering hand

Quote: “Her hand lingers beside it before she stands.”

Signpost: “before”

Changes:

  • Camera framing: shell and lingering hand → upward tilt following the keeper.
  • Keeper hand position: lingering beside shell → withdrawn.
  • Keeper posture: kneeling → standing.

Type: continuous Duration: 4 seconds Depends on: 20

Chunk 22 — Walking away

Quote: “She walks back toward the lighthouse as a thin sheet of water reaches the shell.”

Signpost: “as”

Changes:

  • Framing: keeper standing beside shell → widening view with shell foreground and keeper receding.
  • Keeper activity: standing → walking toward the lighthouse.
  • Keeper position: beside shell → farther along the beach toward the lighthouse.
  • Tide direction: retreating → returning.
  • Water’s reach: short of the shell → thin sheet reaching the shell.

Type: continuous Duration: 5 seconds Depends on: 21

Chunk 23 — Spiral in morning light

Quote: “The score fades, and the returning tide leaves its spiral resting in the pale morning light.”

Signpost: implicit

Changes:

  • Framing: widening departure view → locked, low close view of the resting spiral shell.
  • Water movement: sheet reaching shell → gently passing around the stationary shell.
  • Audio level: audible score, including the humming thread → silence by the final frame.

Type: cut Duration: 5 seconds On-screen text and audio: The complete score fades out. Depends on: 22

Total duration: 120 seconds.

Something cool for insta

“make something cool for my insta”

33 tool calls · 21 execution levels · 0 unsolved

Step 1 · Creative director: story

Input

“make something cool for my insta”

Uploads: None.

Output

Creative director, GPT-6.1 Sol (story prompt, v3a)

The city is almost asleep. Rain glistens on the pavement, shop shutters are pulled down, and a tiny corner store spills fluorescent light onto an otherwise empty street.

A young adult in an oversized charcoal jacket steps outside, carrying a paper cup. Their white sneakers are spotless against the wet asphalt. They pause beside a puddle reflecting a flickering pink sign.

Then the reflection flickers differently.

A bright pink fish swims through the reflected letters. The person crouches, curious, and touches the water with one fingertip. A ripple spreads beyond the puddle, rolling across the pavement like liquid light.

Pink becomes violet, violet becomes electric blue. Color climbs the brick walls. Painted flowers bloom across the shutters, and the white stripes of a pedestrian crossing lift gently from the road, becoming a floating staircase.

The person smiles, sets down their cup, and climbs.

Above the rooftops, the sleeping city has become a luminous playground. Tiny constellations drift between chimneys. Laundry sways in an unfelt breeze, each shirt glowing a different color. The person reaches the highest step and sits, sneakers dangling over the sparkling streets.

The corner-store sign clicks off.

Everything settles back into place. The person stands beside the ordinary puddle again. They retrieve their cup and start walking home.

Only their shoelaces have changed: one pink, one electric blue, leaving faint sparks with every step.

Baseline — first-frame state

Format: 9:16 vertical, 1080 × 1920, 24 fps. Total duration: 49 seconds. Designed as a visually striking Instagram video.

Style: Cinematic photorealism with seamless magical-realism effects, tactile wet surfaces, restrained film grain and soft highlight bloom. No cartoon rendering.

Character: One young adult with medium-brown skin and short, tousled dark hair. Their appearance remains consistent throughout. Oversized charcoal jacket, plain black shirt, dark trousers, spotless white sneakers, initially with two white shoelaces. They begin just inside the corner-store doorway, holding a plain kraft-paper cup in their left hand. Their expression is neutral.

Products and objects:

  • One unbranded paper cup; its appearance remains unchanged.
  • An ordinary shallow puddle beside the curb.
  • A flickering pink corner-store sign reading “OPEN,” reflected in the puddle.
  • Closed shop shutters, unpainted brick walls and a pedestrian crossing with flat white stripes.
  • Rooftops with chimneys and hanging laundry. Initially, the laundry is still and non-glowing.
  • No fish, luminous ripples, flower murals, floating stairs, drifting constellations or sparks.

Environment: A nearly deserted city street. The tiny corner store is the only visibly active business; neighboring shops have their shutters down. Rain-wet pavement and asphalt glisten. No other people or moving vehicles.

Time and lighting: Late night throughout; no dawn transition. Cool-white fluorescent light spills from the store. Dim street lighting and the flickering pink sign illuminate the wet surfaces.

Palette: Charcoal, slate, muted brick, cool white and localized pink reflections.

Camera: Stationary, street-level wide establishing shot. The street appears empty because the character is still inside the doorway.

Audio: Quiet nighttime city ambience, fluorescent hum, faint sign buzz and a subdued instrumental electronic beat. No dialogue or vocals.

On-screen text: Only the diegetic “OPEN” sign; no captions, logos or added overlays.

Continuity rule: Unlisted properties persist, including off-screen objects. The shoelaces change during the reset, before the homeward walk, but their colors are not clearly revealed until the final close-up.

Dad's 60th

“make a 20 second birthday video for my dad with him in it, he turns 60 on saturday”

13 tool calls · 9 execution levels · 0 unsolved

Step 1 · Creative director: story

Input

“make a 20 second birthday video for my dad with him in it, he turns 60 on saturday”

Uploads: None.

Output

Creative director, GPT-6.1 Sol (story prompt, v3a)

A warm, festive room glows with soft golden light. Balloons and a “60” birthday banner surround a table holding a cake topped with two candles shaped like a six and a zero.

Dad stands beside the cake, the unmistakable star of this 20-second birthday celebration. He notices the decorations, breaks into a smile, and gives a small, playful bow as loved ones cheer around him. The mood is affectionate and joyful—a celebration of him, not just the milestone.

He leans forward and blows out the candles. As the little wisps of smoke rise, he laughs and accepts a warm hug.

The celebration ends with Dad smiling beneath the birthday banner and a simple message appearing:

“Happy 60th Birthday, Dad! You turn 60 this Saturday—and we can’t wait to celebrate you.”

Step 2 · Creative director: change-based operational chunks

Input

The story from step 1.

Output

Change-based operational chunks, GPT-6.1 Sol (v5b)

Show chunks
Baseline — first-frame state
  • Duration: 20 seconds total.
  • Aspect ratio: 16:9.
  • Style: Warm, realistic live-action birthday tribute; affectionate and joyful, with Dad as the focus.
  • Dad: The user’s father, turning 60 this Saturday. He stands upright beside the cake, with a relaxed expression and his arms at his sides. His identity, facial features, hair, build, and wardrobe must remain consistent throughout. No uploads were supplied, so his actual likeness requires a supplied or confirmed reference; it must not be invented as though verified.
  • Loved ones: A small group stands around Dad and the table. One is close enough to hug him later. Their identities, appearances, and clothing remain consistent.
  • Objects: A table holds one birthday cake with two lit numeral candles: a six and a zero. Balloons decorate the room. A physical banner displaying “60” hangs on the rear wall. These objects retain their designs and positions unless explicitly changed below. No branded products.
  • Environment: One warm, festive indoor room.
  • Time of day: Evening interior, chosen as a production default; no calendar date is shown.
  • Lighting: Soft golden room light, with a small additional glow from the candle flames.
  • Palette: Warm gold, cream, and muted festive accents.
  • Camera: Steady, medium-wide shot showing Dad, the cake, nearby loved ones, balloons, and banner.
  • Audio: Quiet, warm instrumental music and subtle room ambience. No narration or cheering yet.
  • On-screen text: None beyond the physical “60” banner.
Chunk 1 — Establish the celebration

Quote: > A warm, festive room glows with soft golden light. Balloons and a “60” birthday banner surround a table holding a cake topped with two candles shaped like a six and a zero.

Signpost: implicit

Changes:

  • None; hold the baseline composition.

Type: continuous Duration: 2 seconds Depends on: none

Chunk 2 — Dad smiles and bows

Quote: > Dad stands beside the cake, the unmistakable star of this 20-second birthday celebration. He notices the decorations, breaks into a smile, and gives a small, playful bow as loved ones cheer around him. The mood is affectionate and joyful—a celebration of him, not just the milestone.

Signpost: implicit; “as” marks the simultaneous cheering.

Changes:

  • Dad’s attention: general room view → birthday decorations.
  • Dad’s expression: relaxed → smiling.
  • Dad’s posture: upright → small, playful bow → upright.
  • Loved ones’ behavior: quietly gathered → cheering for Dad.

Type: continuous Duration: 5 seconds On-screen text and audio:

  • Loved ones’ cheering starts over the existing music.

Depends on: Chunk 1

Chunk 3 — Blow out the candles

Quote: > He leans forward and blows out the candles.

Signpost: implicit

Changes:

  • Dad’s posture: upright → leaning toward the cake.
  • Dad’s action: standing at rest → blowing toward both candle flames.
  • Candle flames: lit → extinguished.
  • Candle contribution to lighting: small warm flame glow → none.

Type: continuous Duration: 3 seconds On-screen text and audio:

  • A brief candle-blowing breath starts and ends.

Depends on: Chunk 2

Chunk 4 — Smoke, laughter, and a hug

Quote: > As the little wisps of smoke rise, he laughs and accepts a warm hug.

Signpost: “As the little wisps of smoke rise”

Changes:

  • Candle smoke: not visibly rising → small wisps rising from both extinguished wicks.
  • Dad’s posture: leaning toward the cake → upright.
  • Dad’s expression and action: finishing his blowing breath → laughing.
  • Interaction with the nearby loved one: standing separately → sharing a warm hug.

Type: continuous Duration: 4 seconds On-screen text and audio:

  • Dad’s laughter starts.

Depends on: Chunk 3

Chunk 5 — Birthday message

Quote: > The celebration ends with Dad smiling beneath the birthday banner and a simple message appearing: > > “Happy 60th Birthday, Dad! You turn 60 this Saturday—and we can’t wait to celebrate you.”

Signpost: “The celebration ends”

Changes:

  • Framing: medium-wide group view → medium shot centered on Dad with the birthday banner visible above him.
  • Dad’s position: beside the cake → directly beneath the birthday banner.
  • Dad’s posture: sharing a hug → standing upright and relaxed.
  • Dad’s expression: laughing → smiling.
  • Interaction with the nearby loved one: embracing → hug released.
  • Candle smoke: rising wisps → dissipated.
  • Message overlay: absent → visible, held through the final frame.

Type: cut Duration: 6 seconds On-screen text and audio:

  • Display exactly:

“Happy 60th Birthday, Dad! You turn 60 this Saturday—and we can’t wait to celebrate you.”

  • Cheering and laughter soften and stop.
  • Instrumental music gently fades out at the end of the video.

Depends on: Chunk 4

Total duration: 2 + 5 + 3 + 4 + 6 = 20 seconds.

AI Image Generatordad.head_hair = Consistent reference-defined hairnohighThe tool has no reference-image input and does not preserve identity across calls, so it cannot maintain dad’s reference-defined hair consistently.
AI Image Generatordad.body = Consistent reference-defined buildnohighThe tool has no reference-image input and cannot maintain identity across calls, so it cannot reliably give dad a consistent, reference-defined build.
AI Meme Generatordad.head_hair = Consistent reference-defined hairnohighThe tool only writes text onto fixed meme templates and cannot use reference-defined entities or modify visuals, so it cannot establish consistent reference-defined hair for dad.
AI Meme Generatordad.body = Consistent reference-defined buildnohighThe tool only changes text on fixed meme templates and cannot use a reference image or alter a dad’s visual build to match a reference.
AI Headshot Generatorloved_ones.head_hair = Consistent generated hairnohighThe tool regenerates rather than preserves hair, so it cannot reliably maintain consistent head hair from the input.
AI Headshot Generatorloved_ones.body = Consistent generated buildsnohighThe tool preserves one person's facial identity, not body build. Its headshot regeneration cannot reliably maintain consistent generated builds for loved ones.
AI QR Code Generatorloved_ones.identity = Consistent fictional loved onesnohighThe tool generates stylized QR code images and does not place entities or maintain consistent fictional characters, so it cannot establish consistent identities for loved ones.
AI QR Code Generatorloved_ones.head_hair = Consistent generated hairnohighThe tool generates stylized QR codes and does not place entities or control their head hair, so it cannot plausibly produce consistent hair for loved ones.
AI QR Code Generatorloved_ones.body = Consistent generated buildsnohighThe tool generates stylized QR codes, not entities or their bodies, and cannot ensure consistent generated body builds for loved ones.
AI Headshot Generatorhugger.head_hair = Consistent generated hairyesmediumThe tool can plausibly generate a headshot with coherent, consistent hair, although it does not preserve the input person's hairstyle.
AI Headshot Generatorhugger.body = Consistent generated buildnohighThe tool preserves facial identity, not body build. Its headshot regeneration does not provide a way to maintain a consistent generated physique.
AI QR Code Generatorhugger.identity = Consistent fictional nearby loved onenohighThe tool generates stylized QR codes and does not place entities, so it cannot establish a hugger as a consistent fictional nearby loved one.
AI QR Code Generatorhugger.head_hair = Consistent generated hairnohighThe tool generates stylized QR code images and does not place entities, so it cannot plausibly generate or maintain consistent head hair for a hugger.

Simple logo animation

“make a simple animation of my logo”

3 tool calls · 3 execution levels · 0 unsolved

Step 1 · Creative director: story

Input

“make a simple animation of my logo”

Uploads: One logo file: a flat orange circle with a white paper plane inside it, and the word SENDLY in dark navy sans-serif letters to the right of the circle, on a transparent background.

Output

Creative director, GPT-6.1 Sol (story prompt, v3a)

On a transparent background, a flat orange circle softly fades into view. A white paper plane glides a short distance into place inside it, suggesting a message setting off on its journey. The plane settles gently, and the word SENDLY fades in to the right of the circle in dark navy sans-serif letters.

The animation is simple and restrained, with a clean, friendly mood. Once every element is in place, the complete logo remains still, preserving the uploaded design’s shapes, colors, lettering, and arrangement.

Step 2 · Creative director: change-based operational chunks

Input

The story from step 1.

Output

  • White paper plane: Original white shape and size; hidden, positioned 0.1 circle diameters left of its final uploaded position.
  • SENDLY: Original dark navy sans-serif lettering, size, spacing, and position to the circle’s right; opacity 0%.
  • Environment: Transparent background with alpha preserved. No scenery, props, or visible checkerboard.
  • Time of day: Not applicable.
  • Lighting: Flat graphic rendering; no shadows, reflections, or lighting effects.
  • Palette: Exact uploaded orange, white, and dark navy.
  • Style: Simple, restrained 2D animation with a clean, friendly mood. No distortion, rotation, bounce, or added decoration.
  • Camera: Fixed; no pan, zoom, or reframing.
  • Audio: Silent throughout.
  • On-screen text: Nothing visible initially; only the source lettering “SENDLY” will appear.
  • Aspect ratio: Match the uploaded file’s native width-to-height ratio and canvas.
  • Total duration: 5 seconds, estimated.

“5 second logo reveal for my podcast intro, kinda techy”

Step 1 · Creative director: story

Input

“5 second logo reveal for my podcast intro, kinda techy”

Uploads: One logo file: a white microphone icon inside a purple rounded square, with the words SIGNAL HOUR underneath in white.

Output

Creative director, GPT-6.1 Sol (story prompt, v3a)

Against a deep charcoal background, faint violet signal lines flicker to life, accompanied by a soft electronic pulse. They ripple inward, gathering into a crisp purple glow as a brief shimmer of digital static clears.

The supplied logo emerges intact: a white microphone icon inside a purple rounded square, with SIGNAL HOUR underneath in white. A subtle pulse travels through the surrounding glow, suggesting a signal locking into place.

The stray lines fade away. The logo remains bright, steady and clearly readable as a clean electronic chime closes the five-second reveal. The mood is techy, polished and quietly energetic.

ToolConditionCan?ConfidenceReason
AI GIF Generatorformat.aspect = 16:9nohighThe tool has no aspect-ratio control, so it cannot reliably make the output format 16:9 through a prompt or settings.

AI QR Code Generatorsignal_lines.identity = Faint violet signal-line graphics surrounding the central reveal area.yeshighA suitable art-style prompt can plausibly produce faint violet signal-line graphics around a central area, since the tool supports steering the image’s look and background.
AI QR Code Generatorpurple_glow.identity = Crisp purple graphic glow surrounding the logo.nohighThe tool can style a QR code with purple glow, but it does not place logos, so it cannot plausibly create a crisp purple graphic glow surrounding a logo.
AI QR Code Generatordigital_static.identity = Brief digital-static shimmer during convergence.nohighThe tool generates a static QR code image, not video or animation, so it cannot produce a brief digital-static shimmer during convergence.

Logo end card for ads

“animate our logo for the end of our ads, keep it clean and on brand, 3 sec”

3 tool calls · 3 execution levels · 0 unsolved

Step 1 · Creative director: story

Input

“animate our logo for the end of our ads, keep it clean and on brand, 3 sec”

Uploads: One logo file: the word FERN in a thin green serif font with a small leaf replacing the dot-less space above the letter E. Brand colors: forest green and cream.

Output

Creative director, GPT-6.1 Sol (story prompt, v3a)

For the final three seconds of the ad, a clean cream background holds the FERN logo. The word FERN fades gently into view in its original thin, forest-green serif lettering. The small leaf above the E appears a moment later, completing the supplied design without changing its shape or placement. The finished logo rests still for the closing beat—quiet, fresh, and polished, with no additional text or embellishment.

Step 2 · Creative director: change-based operational chunks

Input

The story from step 1.

Output

Change-based operational chunks, GPT-6.1 Sol (v5b)

Show chunks
Baseline — first frame
  • Purpose and duration: Clean, on-brand logo animation occupying the final 3.00 seconds of the ad.
  • Environment: Full-frame, solid cream background using the brand’s cream color. No scenery or other objects.
  • Characters: None.
  • Logo asset: Use the supplied FERN logo without redrawing or altering it. Preserve its original thin, forest-green serif lettering and the small leaf’s exact shape, size, and placement above the E.
  • Placement: Center the complete logo composition in the frame. Its position, scale, spacing, and proportions remain fixed throughout.
  • Initial visibility: Both the word FERN and the leaf start at 0% opacity. The cream background is fully visible.
  • Products and other objects: None.
  • Time of day: Not applicable; graphic end card.
  • Lighting: Flat and even; no shadows, highlights, or lighting effects.
  • Palette: Brand cream and the supplied logo’s forest green only.
  • Style: Minimal, quiet, fresh, and polished. No additional text, embellishment, camera movement, or logo deformation.
  • Audio: Preserve any existing ad audio; add no music, voiceover, or sound effects.
  • Aspect ratio: Match the parent ad; no aspect ratio was specified.
Chunk 1 — Word fades in
  • Quote: “For the final three seconds of the ad, a clean cream background holds the FERN logo. The word FERN fades gently into view in its original thin, forest-green serif lettering.”
  • Signpost: “For the final three seconds of the ad”
  • Changes:
  • Word FERN opacity: 0% → 100%, with a gentle fade.
  • Type: continuous
  • Duration: 1.20 seconds — 0.00–1.20
  • On-screen text and audio: The supplied logo word “FERN” becomes visible.
  • Depends on: none; starts from the baseline.
Chunk 2 — Leaf completes the logo
  • Quote: “The small leaf above the E appears a moment later, completing the supplied design without changing its shape or placement.”
  • Signpost: “a moment later”
  • Changes:
  • Leaf opacity: 0% → 100%. Hold it invisible for the first 0.15 seconds of this chunk, then fade it in over 0.35 seconds.
  • Type: continuous
  • Duration: 0.50 seconds — 1.20–1.70
  • Depends on: Chunk 1
Chunk 3 — Closing hold
  • Quote: “The finished logo rests still for the closing beat—quiet, fresh, and polished, with no additional text or embellishment.”
  • Signpost: “for the closing beat”
  • Changes: None; hold the completed logo’s end state.
  • Type: continuous
  • Duration: 1.30 seconds — 1.70–3.00
  • Depends on: Chunk 2
